subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class II

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class II English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Mridang (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Mridang, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Listens to rhymes, songs and stories read aloud.
outcomes.note: Short passages are heard with questions; songs are not sung in the app.
Tap-this-then-that instructions are practised; directions in a game are not.

outcomes.text: Recites poems with rhythm and expression.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Keeps a conversation going over several turns and talks about a picture.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Narrates a story or a journey.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads short poems and stories, naming the characters and what they do.
Matches letters with sounds and reads sight words and blends such as ch, sh and bl.
outcomes.note: Words are heard and matched with pictures; blends are not taught on their own.

outcomes.text: Claps syllables and finds rhyming words.
outcomes.note: Syllables are practised; rhyming words are not.

outcomes.text: Writes a caption or one or two sentences for a drawing.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes short sentences, also from dictation.
Builds a sentence from jumbled words.
Uses naming words, action words and describing words such as colours.
Uses in, on, near, under, beside, before and after.
Uses this and that, a and an, and I, he, she, my and them.
Asks questions with who, what, how, where and which.
